name: reverse-engineering
description: Investigate software with REA and Computer Use, then iterate implementation, original/candidate comparison, and repairs within an evidence-backed reconstruction scope.

interface.shortDescription: Investigate apps, binaries, and real website flows.
interface.longDescription: Run REA CLI and MCP sessions from skills, with provider setup and Docker launchers. Reconstruction requests maintain scoped obligations, questions, current implementation fingerprints, and comparisons while Codex iterates investigation, implementation, repair, and regression checks.
defaultPrompt: Explain how the selected app feature works using artifact and runtime evidence.
Use the selected website to investigate its search and detail flow, recording actions, observed states, and unknowns.
Reconstruct the selected feature and iterate original/candidate comparisons until the declared required cases pass or a concrete blocker remains.
